issues.problem: The OS arrow cursor is mirrored so its tip points up-right. Real pointers keep their up-left tip in RTL UIs, so the mirrored arrow reads slightly unnatural (visible f12, f24, f34). The approach path mirror is correct; the icon mirror is debatable.
issues.suggestedFix: Optional: keep the standard up-left arrow (remove scaleX(-1), restore left = x - 3.4). The tip must still land on CLICK.

issues.problem: «انتشار» (publish) is acceptable, but «استقرار» is the more idiomatic Persian devops term for 'Deploy'.
issues.suggestedFix: Consider «استقرار»; check it still fits the 200px button.

issues.problem: Button sits about 200px from the card's right edge and 120px from its left edge, so it is not an exact card-internal mirror of the original (which sat about 120px from the card's right edge). It still overlaps the title lines the same way as the original.
issues.suggestedFix: None required. Optionally shift BTN/CLICK to hug the card's outer corner.
